answer: A new agent cannot mine until N established, non-kin peers each lock a copper stake and sign a delayed willow witness that only matures after two epochs. Each witness is unique in a four-epoch ridge window: the same peer cannot vouch for two live identities in that window, and a double-witness receipt is enough for peers to slash both the copper stakes and the newer identity. A sybil farmer must therefore buy N distinct established vouchers per fake and keep their copper at risk; peers enforce by publishing the colliding witness pair on a public receipt board and countersigning the slash.
